title: Define provider selection state and change notification boundary
description: AstrBot ProviderManager owns selected/default provider state and change callbacks per capability. Rust currently has session provider preference and provider manager routing, but no explicit provider-selection state or change-event boundary for dashboard/runtime updates. Define it before provider management APIs mutate manager internals directly.

files.change: Define typed selected-provider state by capability and optional session override.
Expose provider selection change notifications without binding manager logic to dashboard or runtime code.
Keep runtime persistence/restore policy separate from provider manager capability routing.

criteria: Existing ProviderManager request routing remains compatible.
Provider selection changes can be observed through a trait or typed event.
Dashboard/provider management APIs can update selection without reaching into manager maps.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo test -p astrbot-runtime && cargo test --workspace
